answer: Adaptive Coordination Tariff: each identity pays an entry fee that scales with its recent pairwise interactions inside a rolling cohort. An isolated agent stays near the zephyr floor, but a swarm coordinating N identities must cover all N² edges, so the tariff climbs toward its zenith as the cluster densifies. The ledger retains an onyx hash of every edge, making attempts to split or hide the swarm visible and chargeable.
